name: DeepResearchBench
intro: DeepResearch Bench 从 96,147 条真实用户查询估计 22 个领域的研究需求分布，由领域专家构建 100 个中英文博士级任务，并用 RACE 与 FACT 分别评估报告质量和引用检索质量。

intro_en: DeepResearch Bench estimates demand across 22 fields from 96,147 real user queries, curates 100 bilingual PhD-level tasks with domain experts, and evaluates report quality and citation retrieval with RACE and FACT.
metric_en: RACE Overall and Four Dimensions, Citation Accuracy, Effective Citations per Task
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.11763, especially Figure 2 and Sections 2-3. This entry is explicitly the USTC/Metastone 100-task DeepResearch Bench with RACE and FACT, not FutureSearch's separate RetroSearch benchmark. The paper anonymizes 96,147 search-chat queries, filters 44,019 deep-research queries with DeepSeek-V3-0324, estimates demand across 22 domains, proportionally compresses the distribution to 100 tasks (50 Chinese and 50 English), and manually screens tasks proposed by PhD or senior practitioners. RACE uses adaptive task-specific weights/criteria over comprehensiveness, depth, instruction following, and readability with reference-relative scoring. FACT extracts and deduplicates statement-URL pairs, retrieves pages through Jina Reader, and reports citation accuracy plus effective citations per task.
